product.name: Automated Reporting & Compliance (ARC)
product.description: A post-award BEAD compliance platform that tracks project progress, spending, milestones, reimbursements, performance, and reporting requirements using validated program data.

product.name: Challenge Process Coordinator (CPC)
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing broadband challenge processes, including evidence collection, rebuttals, map-based workflows, adjudication, communications, and audit-ready outputs.

product.name: Ready Application Processor and Portal (APP)
product.description: An end-to-end application management system for broadband grant programs, covering application intake, eligibility review, evaluation, approval, award, and related records.

product.name: Performance Test & Survey (PT&S)
product.description: A broadband performance testing platform that collects NTIA-compliant speed-test evidence and survey data for BEAD challenges, broadband audits, and funding decisions.

product.name: Ready BOSS
product.description: A broadband office support system that provides an integrated operating environment for managing applications, evaluations, challenges, reporting, compliance, performance, and infrastructure program data.

product.name: BEAD Post-Award Success Hub
product.description: A guidance and support service for organizations executing BEAD awards, with assistance focused on program delivery, compliance, reporting, reimbursements, and post-award oversight.
